_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::shell#3, and a FALSIFICATION of it. The entry said the director vector 'must be SPECIFIED or auto-computed from element normal' and advised smoothed nodal directors on curved meshes. There is no way to specify one: appending 'DIR 0 0 1' to a SHELL7P line is rejected with "After parsing, the line still contains 'DIR 0 0 1'." from core/io/src/4C_io_input_spec.cpp, and the same diagnostic prints the element's entire accepted key set — AXI, CIR, EAS, FIBER1..3, MAT, RAD, SDC, THICK, USE_ANS — which contains no director entry at all (DIRECTOR_KEY_IN_ACCEPTED_LIST=0). The vector keys that do exist are material-orientation data, not directors: adding FIBER1 1 0 0 is accepted and leaves the answer bit-identical, so the same result test pinned to 1e-12 still passes (FIBER1_RESULT_FAILURES=0). The director is computed by the element and is not user input on this build. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: After parsing, the line still contains 'DIR 0 0 1'.
Parsed parameters: AXI : none CIR : none EAS : N_4 N_4 N_4 none none FIBER1 : none FIBER2 : none FIBER3 : none MAT : 1 RAD : none SDC : 1 THICK : 0.01 USE_ANS : 1

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: stop trying to give the element a director. The leftover-token diagnostic and the printed key list both vanish and EXIT_DIR becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
